# Synthetic source for graph parsing tests only. Never loaded or deployed.
from datetime import timedelta
from temporalio import workflow

@workflow.defn(name="url_digest")
class GraphFixture:
    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, params):
        page = await workflow.execute_activity("http_fetch", params)
        if page["status"] >= 400:
            return {"summary": "Fetch failed"}
        digest = await workflow.execute_activity(
            "agent_call", {"prompt": page["body"]}, start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=10),
        )
        await workflow.execute_activity("save_artifact", digest)
        return digest
